options.label: G — Pocket memory
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Create ONE exceptionally crafted application icon for Daythread, a private app that records your daily conversations and makes them into a searchable personal memory.
Art direction: a richly designed tactile object with restrained dimensional depth, distinctive product illustration, like a treasured modern instrument. NOT a minimalist flat glyph. NOT glowing generic AI glass. Strong clear central subject, meaningful small details.
Subject: a compact beautifully sculpted rounded audio-memory pebble made from matte midnight ceramic and warm brushed copper. A recessed central sound waveform is cut into the ceramic face; one fine copper thread exits a tiny side slot, wraps around the object once, and ends as a small bookmark tab. The object evokes an elegant wearable voice recorder that keeps your day's memories. The copper loop creates a beautiful distinctive silhouette, and should have intentional physical construction. A tiny single amber recording indicator adds life. Front three-quarter view, shallow perspective, premium proportions, subtle ceramic grain, exquisite copper edges, soft realistic contact shadow.
Background: deep muted petrol-blue full-bleed square, softly lit, no outer rounded corners or border. Centered object occupies about 70 percent of canvas, generous mask-safe area. Colors rich midnight, brushed warm copper, tiny warm ivory waveform inset. Sophisticated small-scale product illustration with real material variation. No text, no initials, no oversized neon, no lens flare, no sparkles, no floating UI, no book, no speech bubble, no mockup. Exactly one finished icon.

options.label: H — Conversation archive
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Create ONE distinctive, richly crafted modern app icon for Daythread, a private personal audio memory app. It captures conversations, keeps them by day, and helps you find moments again.
Concept: an elegant small archive of audible memories. Three thick rounded memory tiles overlap in a gentle fan, like treasured captured moments. The front tile is midnight enamel with a precise warm-ivory sound waveform inset into its surface. The two tiles behind are burnished copper and muted sea-green, each bearing a few subtle engraved lines of transcription. A single warm copper binding thread passes through the upper corners and connects all three cards. This detail should look physically convincing and beautifully resolved, giving Daythread a recognizable identity. ONE integrated centered object, no loose confetti or unrelated ornaments.
Style: premium tactile dimensional illustration, careful material realism, softly chamfered edges, restrained highlights, exquisite typography-free industrial design. More visual substance than a simple logo, quieter than a glossy gaming icon. Beautiful layered composition and crisp silhouette that still works on an iPhone home screen. Frontal with a slight three-quarter depth, no extreme perspective.
Background: rich off-white linen-colored square with a subtle natural contact shadow, no outer rounded corners, no frame. Icon takes around 70 percent of canvas with safe margins. No lettering, no words, no numerals, no neon glow, no glass gradients, no sparkles, no book, no microphone stand, no UI screenshot. Exactly one finished square icon.

options.label: I — A day in sound
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Create ONE beautifully illustrated app icon for Daythread, a private application that remembers your day through recorded conversations and lets you revisit moments.
Concept: a miniature landscape made entirely from ribbons of recorded sound, held inside one substantial rounded-square keepsake frame. Three overlapping wavy bands form a coherent layered landscape: warm terracotta foreground, muted peach middle, and deep teal background. Their upper edges follow subtle natural speech-wave contours rather than regular equalizer bars. A single fine ivory thread travels through all three bands, creating a winding path through your remembered day. A small recessed golden disc near the upper-right horizon suggests the passage of a day. The frame is dark midnight teal ceramic with beautifully crafted thick edges, restrained tangible depth. Clear, memorable centered object with detail to discover, not an abstract corporate logo.
Art direction: richly colored sculpted paper-and-ceramic illustration, precise contours, soft directional studio shadows, tactile matte surfaces, human and sophisticated. Strong composition with substantial visual character. No extreme gradients, no chrome, no neon, no glowing light rays, no excessive fine texture. It must read as an intentional icon, not a full scenic painting.
Background: warm dark ink square full bleed, no outer rounded corners, no external frame beyond the actual keepsake object. Centered keepsake takes 70 percent of canvas, uniform safe margins. No words, no letters, no numbers, no book, no speech bubble, no microphone, no UI mockup, no watermark. Exactly one finished app icon.
